services.desc: The Mill and its gardens provide the perfect backdrop for your summer or fall event. We host several every season and the photo shoots are fabulous. For a wedding reception with guests seated at tables, the maximum capacity is up to 60 people plus a head table. The two washrooms are located on this level, which is wheelchair accessible. On the upper level, theatre seating for a wedding ceremony is 130 people. For a wedding reception with table seating, capacity is 100 people plus a head table. services.name: Mill Exhibits
services.desc: The Spencerville Mill is always adding more exhibits and displays to its already existing collection. This preview will show you some of our stationary displays as well as preview our plans for the Mill in coming years. This level of the Mill is fully wheelchair accessible and showcases how the grist operation was run as well as why the Spencerville Mill was so successful due to its location and approximation to various trade routes. You can see the single roller mill run using the turbine water power, and feel the floor vibrate with the rotations.
